title: Log file rotation with maximum backup files count

workspace.test_rotator.py:
from rotator import LogRotator

def test_rotator():
    lr = LogRotator(max_files=2)
    lr.write('l1'); lr.write('l2'); lr.write('l3')
    assert len(lr.logs) == 2
    assert lr.logs == ['l2', 'l3']
